judgment_calls.topic: Meningitis bullet: 'Temperature ≥ 38°C, headache, neck stiffness or purple/red rash'
judgment_calls.decision: Read literally as any one of the four (with a fit) -> probable meningitis.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Temperature >= 38 AND any of headache/neck stiffness/rash; or all four. The next bullet (new/worse headache) suggests headache alone was not meant to suffice.

judgment_calls.decision: Probable Vasovagal syncope from collapse + muscle twitch + any of flushing/dizziness/nausea/sweating; duration < 15 s and rapid recovery dropped (not representable); not conditioned on seizure being ruled out.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Leave unencoded; or require (no Seizure), which conflicts with the Seizure trigger.
